Full Terms and Conditions These terms and conditions govern the Black Friday GoWild Annual Pass Elite Status Points promotion offered by Frontier Airlines, Inc.
The Promotion Terms supplement, and apply in addition to, the GoWild Pass Terms and Conditions, the GoWild Annual Pass Terms and Conditions, and the Frontier Miles Terms and Conditions.
Promotion Description Frontier will credit 10,000 Elite Status Points to the Frontier Miles account of each eligible pass holder for whom a 2027 GoWild Annual Pass is purchased between 12:00 a.m.
Eligibility The Promotion is available to new GoWild Pass members only.
A pass holder who has held a GoWild Pass of any type before the start of the Promotion Period is not eligible.

Frontier reserves the right to modify, suspend, or cancel the Promotion at any time, and to disqualify any purchaser or pass holder determined to have engaged in fraud, abuse, or a violation of these terms.

Black Friday GoWild Referral Terms: 5,000 Elite Status Points per Referral Full Terms and Conditions These terms and conditions govern the Black Friday GoWild Referral Incentive promotion offered by Frontier Airlines, Inc.
These Referral Promotion Terms supplement, and apply in addition to, the GoWild Pass Terms and Conditions, the GoWild Annual Pass Terms and Conditions, and the Frontier Miles Terms and Conditions.
Promotion Description Eligible current 2027 GoWild Annual Pass holders (each, a “Referring Pass Holder”) may earn 5,000 Elite Status Points for each Qualifying Referral.
The referred customer must be a new GoWild member who has never held a GoWild Pass of any type before the start of the Referral Promotion Period.
Qualifying Purchases A purchase qualifies only if it is a 2027 GoWild Annual Pass purchased by a Qualifying Referral during the Referral Promotion Period.
Purchases made outside the Referral Promotion Period, purchases by customers who have previously held a GoWild Pass, and purchases that are not attributed to a Referring Pass Holder do not qualify.

Referral Tracking and Validation Frontier will use a manual batch process after the Referral Promotion Period ends to (i) confirm that the Referring Pass Holder had already purchased or early renewed a 2027 GoWild Annual Pass before referring and (ii) confirm that each referred customer is a net-new GoWild member.
Maximum Awards Each Referring Pass Holder may earn a maximum of 25,000 Elite Status Points under the Referral Promotion, equal to five (5) Qualifying Referrals.

Referral Points will be credited to the Referring Pass Holder’s Frontier Miles account within five (5) business days after the Referral Promotion Period ends (on or before December 14, 2026) Referral Points are Elite Status Points only.
